limits: This evidence checks digital geometry only; it does not establish factory switch interchangeability, retention force, electrical fit, preload, or physical manufacture.
Press travel is sampled at 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0 mm; no continuous-motion proof is claimed between samples.
D-shaft matching-angle probes and guide/key travel are virtual evaluated-coordinate checks; source objects are not moved or saved.
The inspector reads evaluated scene geometry and does not mutate or save the source scene.
